name: Heirloom Beefsteak Tomatoes
description: Richly ribbed, deeply aromatic heirloom tomatoes packed with complex umami sweetness. Hand-picked ripe from the vine at dawn.
storageTip: Store stem-down at room temperature; avoid refrigerator chilling to preserve delicate sugars and aromatics.
nutrition: High in Lycopene, Vitamin C, Potassium

name: Rainbow Bunch Carrots
description: Crisp purple, amber, solar yellow, and crimson carrots with lush feathery tops. Naturally sweet with an earthy crunch.
storageTip: Snip green tops 1 inch above crown; submerge in cold water bowl or wrap in damp cloth inside crisper.

name: Crisp Gala Apples
description: Orchard-fresh heirloom Gala apples featuring dense, ivory flesh with crisp snap and sweet vanilla-floral undertones.
storageTip: Keep chilled in the refrigerator crisper drawer with high humidity; lasts 3-4 weeks.

name: Wild Forest Mushrooms
description: Foraged chanterelles, black trumpets, and cultivated oyster clusters with rich forest earthiness and velvety texture.
storageTip: Store loosely in a brown paper bag in refrigerator; never seal in plastic or wash until ready to sauté.

name: Tuscan Lacinato Kale
description: Dark blue-green pebbled dinosaur kale with deep earthy minerality, tender leaves, and sweet finish after light frost.
storageTip: Wrap stems in damp paper towel and enclose in reusable cloth sack; wash right before preparation.
nutrition: Vitamins K, A, C, Calcium, Iron

name: Sweet Japanese Sweet Potatoes
description: Murasaki and Satsumaimo sweet potatoes with burgundy skin and golden cream flesh that caramelizes to honey sweetness.
storageTip: Keep in a cool, dark, well-ventilated pantry; never store in the refrigerator.

name: Meyer Lemons
description: A cross between a true lemon and mandarin orange. Thin fragrant peel, low acidity, and floral herbal sweetness.
storageTip: Room temperature for 1 week; refrigerate in a sealed crisper pouch for up to 1 month.

name: Fresh Genovese Basil
description: Lush emerald leaves with potent clove-peppery essential oils, cut minutes before market opening.
storageTip: Trim stems and place like flowers in a glass of water on kitchen counter; never refrigerate.

name: Black Mission Figs
description: Decadently jammy purple-black figs with pink interior, bursting with rich honeyed berry sweetness.
storageTip: Consume within 48 hours; chill on a plate in single layer if keeping for 2-3 days.

name: English Cucumbers
description: Thin-skinned seedless cucumbers with refreshing coolness, tender skin that requires no peeling.
storageTip: Keep dry and store in warmest part of refrigerator (top shelf) to avoid cold pit damage.

name: Sugar Snap Peas
description: Thick-walled crunchy pods bursting with sweet botanical juice. Eat raw, steamed, or tossed into grain salads.
storageTip: Store unwashed in a breathable mesh bag in the crisper drawer for up to 5 days.

name: Golden Beets
description: Radiant yellow beets with a mild, sweet, non-earthy flavor profile that will not bleed magenta in salads.
storageTip: Remove green tops and store firm roots in perforated produce bag for up to 3 weeks.

name: Kabocha Squash
description: Japanese heirloom pumpkin with deep forest rind and dense, chestnut-flavored golden flesh perfect for roasting.
storageTip: Cured winter squash keeps at cool room temperature (50-60°F) for up to 3 months.

name: Valencia Oranges
description: Sun-drenched juice oranges with vibrant citrus perfume, thin skin, and unparalleled sugar-to-acid balance.
storageTip: Store at cool room temperature for up to 10 days, or refrigerated for up to 3 weeks.

name: Artisanal Goat Chevre
description: Pillow-soft fresh goat cheese rolled in wild culinary herbs, crafted from pasture-grazed heritage goats.
storageTip: Keep tightly wrapped in parchment paper and refrigerated; best enjoyed within 10 days of opening.

name: Wild Mountain Lavender Honey
description: Raw, unheated floral nectar harvested from mountain ridge apiaries. Delicate herbal notes and crystalline texture.
storageTip: Keep in a sealed glass jar at room temperature. If crystallization occurs, gently warm jar in warm water bath.

name: Cultured Farmstead Butter
description: Golden churned butter cultured with live probiotic flora for a tangy, rich, European-style 84% butterfat richness.
storageTip: Keep refrigerated; can remain at room temperature in a butter crock for 7 days of spreadability.

name: Organic Rosemary Sprigs
description: Piney, resinous perennial rosemary needles harvested from maritime hillside bushes for savory roasted vegetable dishes.
storageTip: Wrap in slightly damp paper towel and seal in a produce container in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

name: Spring Strawberries
description: Fragrant Albion and Seascape strawberries bred for concentrated sweetness and bright ruby-red interior flesh.
storageTip: Do not wash until ready to eat; store single layer with a paper towel in a breathable container.

name: Crisp Romanesco Broccoli
description: Hypnotic logarithmic fractal spirals with a nutty, sweeter nuance than traditional broccoli or cauliflower.
storageTip: Refrigerate in a loose produce bag; best prepared within 5 days of harvest.

name: Purple Asparagus
description: Heirloom violet spears with 20% higher natural sugar content than green varieties and tender edible stalks.
storageTip: Stand upright with bottoms submerged in 1 inch of water in refrigerator, loosely tented with a bag.

name: Microgreen Medley
description: Spicy radish, red cabbage, broccoli, and pea shoot microgreens packed with up to 40x the nutrient density of mature plants.
storageTip: Store chilled between dry paper towels; lasts up to 10 days in sealed container.

name: Crimson Radishes
description: Crisp globe radishes with peppery snap, tender green tops great for making garden pestos.
storageTip: Cut tops off and store radishes in cold water jar in fridge for crispness that lasts 2 weeks.

name: Fresh Thyme Sprigs
description: French and English culinary thyme with tiny aromatic leaves and woodsy, lemon-clove aromatic warmth.
storageTip: Refrigerate rolled in damp cloth inside an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Organic Hass Avocados
description: Coastal-grown rich Hass avocados with buttery nutty flesh, creamy texture, and elevated monounsaturated oils.
storageTip: Ripen at room temperature until gently yielding; once ripe, refrigerate to suspend ripening for up to 5 days.

name: Concord Grapes
description: Deep indigo heirloom slip-skin grapes with quintessential rich grape jelly aroma and bold tart-sweet flavor.
storageTip: Store unwashed in original ventilated container in the refrigerator crisper for up to 10 days.

name: Golden Honeycomb
description: Pure beeswax comb dripping with golden clover and wildflower honey. Chewable, 100% natural and unrefined.
storageTip: Store at ambient room temperature in an airtight box; honey never spoils naturally.

name: Fresh Mint Leaves
description: Spearmint and Moroccan mint with invigorating menthol essential oils. Perfect for infusions, salads, and mocktails.
storageTip: Store like fresh flowers in a glass of water on counter, or gently wrapped in moist towel in fridge.

name: Delicata Squash
description: Striped oblong squash with edible skin that caramelizes like candied sweet potatoes when sliced and roasted.
storageTip: Keep dry in a cool room (55°F) for up to 6 weeks. No need to peel prior to cooking.

name: Spotted Watermelon
description: Heirloom Moon and Stars yellow and crimson fleshed watermelon with refreshing crisp crunch and high brix sweetness.
storageTip: Whole melons keep at room temp for 7-10 days; once sliced, cover tightly and refrigerate.

name: Baby Arugula
description: Tender young wild arugula leaves with an appetizing peppery mustard bite, harvested in cool dawn hours.
storageTip: Keep chilled in a breathable container with a dry cloth to prevent moisture build-up.

name: Farmhouse Sourdough Bread
description: Slow 36-hour cold fermented bread baked in wood-fired hearth ovens using stoneground whole organic flours.
storageTip: Store cut-side down on a wooden cutting board or in a linen bread bag; never refrigerate.
